endedTitle: This link is no longer available
endedText: This link is no longer valid: its end date has passed. No worries, the rest of the site is still here.
endedTextDate: This link was valid until {date}. No worries, the rest of the site is still here.
missingText: We can't find this link. It may have been copied with a typo, or removed. No worries, the home page is right here.
localAddress: Your site's public address is not set yet ("{site}"). QR codes created now would lead to an address your visitors cannot open: wait until the site address is set before printing anything.
newSubmit: Create the link and its QR code
helpUrl: Paste the address of the page, for example https://www.mysite.com/shop. No need to worry about the "https://" part: I take care of it.
helpSlug: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. Leave empty and I will suggest a readable one, based on the address or the note, for example "shop".
helpTitle: To find this link again later, for example "Christmas market flyer". Your visitors never see it.
helpExpires: After this day (included), the link shows a friendly page instead of redirecting. Leave empty for a link with no end.
bannerCreated: Your link "{name}" is ready. Here is its QR code: download it, then test it with your phone before printing.
bannerCreatedSuggested: Your link is ready. I named it "{name}" (this name is part of the address). Download its QR code below and test it with your phone before printing.
bannerSaved: Saved. QR codes already printed now lead to this address.
emptyList: No links yet. Paste an address in the form above: the short link and its QR code appear right away.
searchPlaceholder: Search by name, note or address
noMatch: No link matches. Try another word.
qrHint: To put on a poster, a flyer or a stream screen: a phone that scans it opens the link.
dlSvgHint: For a printer or layout software: stays perfect at any size.
dlPngMHint: For a document, a slideshow or a stream panel.
dlPngLHint: For a printed poster or flyer.
printTips: **Before printing**: keep the white margin around the code (do not crop it), put nothing on top of it and allow at least 2.5 cm (1 inch) per side. Always test with your phone.
qrTooLong: The short address is too long for a QR code. Shorten the start of the short address in the advanced settings.
noClicksYet: No clicks yet. As soon as someone opens this link, the numbers will show up here.
chartLabel: Clicks per day over the last 30 days: {month} in total, with a maximum of {best} on {date}.
countingOff: Click counting is switched off in the settings: the numbers no longer move.
helpUrlEdit: You can change the address: the short name and the QR code already printed stay the same and will lead to the new address.
removeText: QR codes already printed will then lead to a "link not found" page.
removeConfirm: Delete the link "{name}" and its numbers? QR codes already printed will stop working.
err_url_empty: Paste the address of the page to shorten, for example https://www.mysite.com/shop.
err_url_long: This address is too long (2,000 characters at most). Try the page address without everything after the "?".
err_url_space: There are spaces in the address. Copy it again in full, without any space, for example https://www.mysite.com/shop.
err_url_scheme: Only web page addresses are accepted, for example https://www.mysite.com/shop (not an email, a phone number or a file).
err_url_invalid: This address is not understood. Write it as in your browser's address bar, for example https://www.mysite.com/shop.
err_url_credentials: The address must not contain a name or a password (what comes before an "@"). Keep only the page address, for example https://www.mysite.com/shop.
err_url_private: This address does not lead to a public site (it is a private computer or network): your visitors could not open it. Use the public address of the page, for example https://www.mysite.com/shop.
err_url_loop: This address leads to a short link of this site or to a technical page. Choose the real destination page, for example https://www.mysite.com/shop.
err_expires_date: Write the date like this: 2026-12-31 (year, month, day).
err_expires_past: This date has already passed, so the link would be useless. Pick a day in the future, or leave empty for a link with no end.
err_slug_short: The short name needs at least 2 characters, for example "{name}".
err_slug_long: The short name is too long (32 characters at most). Try "{name}".
err_slug_chars: Use only lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, for example "{name}".
err_slug_reserved: This name is already taken by the site (a page, a language or a reserved word). Try "{name}".
err_slug_taken: This name is already used by another link. Try "{name}", or leave empty and I will suggest one.
err_form_full: You have reached the {max} links allowed: delete one before creating a new one.
err_form_gone: This link no longer exists. Go back to the list to see your links.
